comment: Lectures can be a bit dry but he is very straightforward and makes an effort to tell jokes. He breaks up class by handing homework back halfway through class which is a nice break. Not a tough grader, if you go to class, do homework, and study some you will do fine. Oh and he uses a textbook he wrote but posts the pdf on sakai so dont have tobuy it

teaches at UNC now. cant say enough good things about him. if you go to class/are engaged/take notes (aka being a student) you can do very well in the class. He wants his students to do well and does not grade to a desired mean/median, like many professors.

Prof Yates is awesome! I just finished my first week in stats 2 with a different prof and I can't begin to describe how much I wish I was in Yates class! He writes his own textbook which is so clear and concise that you don't need to take notes and his lectures make it even clearer. Stats is hard regardless of the teacher but he is a very fair grader who will give you 8/10 if you gave it a good effort. Homework is also minimal. I would highly recommend Yates to everyone

He is absolutely the best Prof. in B school. He makes class fun and explains exactly what he expects of you clearly. He actually teaches! instead of making you read a text book and teach yourself. He made the learning very easy. TAKE HIM!!

He is helpful outside of class. A few hw problems every class but he will help you if you go to his office. Kind of nerdy but is funny. Class is boring. He teaches exactly from the textbook that he wrote. Exams are 5 questions but he gives partial credit.

Has 5 quizes, no big exams and one term paper that he grades very easily. The quizzes are not too bad since he tells you what it will cover. The subject is interesting and he has a good sense of humor. He always made fun of sports mktg professor before him.

Definitely take yates for BStats 1. His book is on netfiles so you don't have to purchase it! The test questions are all just slight variations of the problems in the book. He walks you through everything thoroughly and is a really nice guy. Class is boring but that's just the fault of the subject. Highly reccomended. Easy A.

Yeah, take the ECON 330 class and it will feel like you are taking multivariable calculus. Good teacher, nice guy, but tests are impossible. He likes to give you exams on stuff that you "don't know how to do. Otherwise, it's an insult to your intelligence."
don't you hate when the professor's tests are 10 times harder than any of your classwork could have prepared you for?  yeah, one of those.  avoid him.

Very good young teacher. Teaches from his own notes and you dont need the book. Very clear explanations with good examples. Always replies quickly to e-mail questions. Gives some homework but it is usually easy and quick to do. Test questions are clear and on topic.

A relatively young teacher he seems quite good at teaching and is very clear in most of his explanations. He does give some homework but not as much as other similar professors. He also uses a lot of good examples in his lectures which really helps demonstrate the uses of the material studied.
